title: Tropical cyclone, Madagascar, 8 March 2025 (TC20250308MDG)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Tropical cyclone, Madagascar, 8 March 2025 (TC20250308MDG), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: TC20250308MDG, GDACS ID: 1154**  This map illustrates the potentially affected cropland in Andapa District, Sava Region, Madagascar, based on RCM-2 satellite images acquired on 9 March 2025. In the analyzed area of approximately 680 km², about 145 km² of cropland is identified, of which about 20 km² appears to be affected by floodwaters.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated on the ground. Ground feedback is requested and can be sent to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
Important Note: Flood analysis based on radar images may underestimate the presence of standing water in built-up or densely vegetated areas due to the backscattering properties of the radar signal.
as of 9 March 2025
